ideas.title: The Web of Deceit: Uncovering Minnesota's Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of fraud in Minnesota's childcare programs, including the $4M daycare with no kids and misspelled sign
ideas.angle: Follow the money and uncover the extent of the issue
questions: Who is responsible for the fraud?

ideas.insight: This story could expose a significant abuse of public funds and lead to accountability for those responsible.
